<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Bundles validation results for local parts, ensuring consistent representation across different systems.

Description: 
Created to standardize the representation of local parts in email addresses. Used by validation services to ensure local parts conform to expected formats. Instances are typically created during email validation processes and used to store intermediate validation results.

Attributes:
    local_part (str): The original local part of the email address.
    ascii_local_part (Optional[str]): The ASCII representation of the local part, if available.
    smtputf8 (bool): Indicates whether the local part is encoded in UTF-8 according to SMTP standards.
</DOCSTRING>
